after_element_list.text: Donate old clothes and shoes. Put winter clothes in storage.
Check expiration dates and discard old food. Wipe down shelves.
Make a grocery list based on planned meals. Cook chicken and chop veggies on Sunday.
Catch up on family news. Ask for her famous cookie recipe.
Don	 forget milk, eggs, and bread. Also need to pick up snacks for the kids.
